title: Cyrus and the Veil
author: Tamsin Whitlock
blurb: Gideon Dunmore, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
